title: Robert Beatty
description_html:
Illustration, digital

Robert Beatty is an artist and musician. Most known for his album artwork (Tame Impala — Currents, Ariel Pink — Dedicated to Bobby Jameson), his process of combining traditional illustration techniques and filtering them through an airbrushed, aged, digital realm is what attracted me to his work.

title: Matías Elichabehere-Rhum
description_html:
Music clip and posters for Matías Elichabehere.
Matías a young french producer and singer, his music is sweet and catchy.
"Rhum" is a song about jellyfish, rum and drunkenness. I interpreted this project with metaphorical blurry images. Each clip has been printed and scanned in order to keep the image naturally vaporous and granular.
